character.name: Сахарок
character.languages: Common, Elvish, One language of your choice

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.notes: Take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

actions.name: Sneak Attack
actions.notes: Once per turn, deal extra damage when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage, or when another enemy of the target is within 5 ft of it (and you don't have disadvantage). Damage scales: ⌈level/2⌉d6.

actions.name: Cunning Action
actions.notes: Take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.notes: Weapon • Finesse, Light, Thrown (20/60) • Simple melee weapon. Finesse, light, and thrown — equally at home in a fist or in flight.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.notes: Weapon • Finesse • Martial melee weapon. Finesse — a slender thrusting blade rewarding precision.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.notes: Weapon • Ammunition (80/320), Two-Handed • Simple ranged weapon. Ammunition (80/320 ft.), two-handed.

reactions.name: Opportunity Attack
reactions.notes: When a hostile creature you can see moves out of your reach, you can use your reaction to make one melee attack against it.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.notes: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack, use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you (level 5+).

equippedItems.name: Leather Armor
equippedItems.description: Light armor. AC 11 + Dex modifier. Supple boiled leather that never slows you down.

equippedItems.name: Dagger
equippedItems.description: Simple melee weapon. Finesse, light, and thrown — equally at home in a fist or in flight.

equippedItems.name: Rapier
equippedItems.description: Martial melee weapon. Finesse — a slender thrusting blade rewarding precision.

equippedItems.name: Shortbow
equippedItems.description: Simple ranged weapon. Ammunition (80/320 ft.), two-handed.

backpackItems.name: Backpack
backpackItems.description: A backpack holds 1 cubic foot / 30 pounds of gear. You can also strap items such as a bedroll or a coil of rope to the outside.

backpackItems.name: Bell
backpackItems.description: A small handbell, useful for signalling or as a simple alarm.

backpackItems.name: Candle
backpackItems.description: Burns for 1 hour, giving bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

backpackItems.name: Crowbar
backpackItems.description: Using a crowbar grants advantage on Strength checks where its leverage can be applied.

backpackItems.name: Hammer
backpackItems.description: A one-handed hammer used for driving pitons and general camp work.

backpackItems.name: Piton
backpackItems.description: An iron spike driven into rock or wood to anchor a rope while climbing.

backpackItems.name: Rations (1 day)
backpackItems.description: Dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

backpackItems.name: Tinderbox
backpackItems.description: A small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder. Lighting a torch (or anything with abundant exposed fuel) takes an action; any other fire takes 1 minute.

backpackItems.name: Waterskin
backpackItems.description: Holds 4 pints of liquid. A creature needs roughly 1 gallon of water per day in temperate conditions.

backpackItems.name: Hempen Rope (50 feet)
backpackItems.description: Rope has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check. Useful for climbing, binding, and securing gear.

backpackItems.name: Thieves' Tools
backpackItems.description: Lockpicks, a small file, a mirror on a handle, narrow-bladed scissors, and pliers. Proficiency lets you add your bonus to checks made to disarm traps or open locks.

backpackItems.name: Arrows
backpackItems.description: Ammunition for a bow. You can recover half your expended ammunition after a battle.

classResources.name: Sneak Attack
classResources.description: Extra damage dice (d6s) once per turn with advantage or ally adjacent

racialFeatures.name: Darkvision
racialFeatures.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

racialFeatures.name: Fey Ancestry
racialFeatures.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

racialFeatures.name: Skill Versatility
racialFeatures.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
classFeatures.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage, or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

classFeatures.name: Cunning Action
classFeatures.description: Take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

classFeatures.name: Fast Hands
classFeatures.description: You can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

classFeatures.name: Second-Story Work
classFeatures.description: You gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement. In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.effect: Can't see, auto-fail sight checks, attacks have disadvantage

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.effect: Can't attack charmer, charmer has advantage on social checks

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.effect: Disadvantage on checks while source is in sight, can't move closer

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.effect: Speed becomes 0, can't benefit from speed bonuses

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.effect: Impossible to see, attacks have advantage, attacks against have disadvantage

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.effect: Incapacitated, auto-fail STR and DEX saves, attacks have advantage

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.effect: Transformed into solid substance, incapacitated, resistant to all damage

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.effect: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.effect: Disadvantage on attacks, attacks within 5ft have advantage

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.effect: Speed becomes 0, attacks have disadvantage, attacks against have advantage

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.effect: Incapacitated, auto-fail STR and DEX saves, attacks have advantage

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.effect: Incapacitated, drop everything, prone, auto-fail STR and DEX saves
